purpose: Make the whole music library playable, editable, distributable, and generative across the Static Collective's radio garden, without losing the correct live listener experience or current tower state.

foundations.text: Primary button listens live; Longwave and Same-Time Radio are invisible fallbacks; Road Shuffle remains separately visible; preserve artwork/title and return-to-live after one-off listening.
The authoritative now-playing title/artwork comes from the actual transmitter; a stale website playlist must not masquerade as broadcast truth.
A minimized or backgrounded browser should remain on the authentic live stream through track transitions, with fallback state observable for troubleshooting.
Compost Heap is the living all-tracks station, prioritizing the least-played material; shared blobs may belong to multiple radio stations with editable metadata.
Any track can be enabled/disabled, renamed, reassigned, and reordered without losing stable identity or stale move indices.
Invent, consolidate, replace and prove. Do not preserve obsolete app architecture for compatibility alone, and do not claim a PR is a field result.

next: Verify PR #166 against main, then field-test the real live radio over consecutive track transitions with the browser minimized; capture timestamped transmitter now-playing and observed fallback states.
unknowns: Live minimization behavior on Mac and Android remains unverified in this handoff.
